body:
> The `UniAsserter` thing doesn't work in `@BeforeEach` or `@AfterEach` methods either.

What exactly would you be asserting in `@BeforeEach` or `@AfterEach`? 
Asking because I want to understand the use case. 
We can likely add support for this, but I want to figure out if it's worth it

> What if I could tag my test class/methods with `@Blocking`? That doesn't seem to do anything now, but could it?

Nope, that can't be done, the reason is simple: Hibernate Reactive **must**  run on an event loop thread
Thanks for the detailed description. It will be a while before I look into this however, with PTO coming soon
You know me - I write novels

issue.title: Allow the use of UniAsserter in @BeforeEach and @AfterEach test methods

body: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/19159 will allow the use of  the `UniAsserter` in `@BeforeEach` and `@AfterEach`
That surely was a while before you looked into it...A whole weekend! :)
I turned out to be much easier than I thought :)

FWIW I still think asking uses to learn "yet another" testing framework, after they've just learned how to use `AssertSubscriber`/`UniAssertSubscriber`, is a bit much. Now they have to learn this new `UniAsserter` thing.

What if I need to assert on a `Multi` in a reactive transaction?
